title: Matching edges incident to a part
statement: Let $q,k\in\mathbb{N}$, choose a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part, and fix a part and a position in it. The matching edge containing the vertex at that position belongs to the set of matching edges incident to at least one vertex in the fixed part.
hypotheses_covered: a perfect matching in the complete q-partite graph
